summary: AC2 requires the Fast Lane and Full Pipeline output boxes to appear side-by-side on desktop, but the implementation stacks them vertically (flex-direction: column) inside the outputs zone. This is a structural mismatch with the stated acceptance criterion.

findings.message: The two output boxes (Fast Lane, Full Pipeline) are stacked vertically via flex-direction: column on .dg-outputs. AC2 explicitly requires them 'side-by-side on desktop'. The outputs zone should use flex-direction: row (or a two-row grid) for viewport widths above 600px.
